chosenApproach: Preserve existing R4 verified completion RPC semantics and pre-activation +10; add private future-dated rollout switch, one-per-user/chapter server-side comment INSERT credit trigger and 20-char staging composer. Keep release embargo and account bounds.

Anonymous/inactive/hidden/reply/unreleased comment yields no reward, and duplicate comments cannot mint again.
All three governance and protected-feature checks validate the narrowly scoped PR; no production release or EAS build in this change.
Database/Supabase staging execution remains an explicit blocker until the authenticated BUKLOD MAIN staging project can be verified.
